title: Arctic Mobs
description: This add Arctic mobs to the cold biomes, cause there isn't enough
body:
Have you ever wanted more arctic mobs? Well, this mod as Arctic mobs to minecraft! As of right now it adds:

<details>
<summary>Mammoth</summary>
The first mob I ever made with working attack animations. It is a neutral mob, and spanws in snowy plains and snowy taiga


</details>


<details>
<summary>Credits</summary>
Made by SongfulTulip. Made with Mcreator and Blockbench


</details>


<details>
<summary>Recommended Stuff</summary>
Forge Version: Forge 1.20.1 (47.4.10)
</details>

If you see this mod on any other website, do NOT download it(likely malware)
